<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 13"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Slip Sideways](/Feats.aspx?ID=4563) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Nephilim" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=518" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 81

**Prerequisites**
[Grimspawn](/Feats.aspx?ID=4543), [Pitborn](/Feats.aspx?ID=4547), o[Hellspawn](/Feats.aspx?ID=4544), or another lineage feat associated with fiends or the Maelstrom

</column>

---

Like many fiends, you have the supernatural ability to teleport yourself to safety. Once per day, you can cast [_translocate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1724) as a 5th-rank divine [innate spell](/Rules.aspx?ID=279).
